key.name: width
key.description: The Desktop window's width in pixels (logical pixels, as in the display settings). It is never wider than the screen's free area.

key.name: position
key.description: left or right: against that edge of the screen's free area, full height. center: in the middle, at the height below.

key.name: height
key.description: The window's height in pixels when it sits in the middle; 0 is full height. On the left or right it is always full height.

key.name: open-at-login
key.description: Open the Focus Tracker Desktop window when you log in, if it is not open.

key.name: title
key.description: The exact title of the window to pin (the Desktop page sets it).
